gates.why: Performance budgets checked by `scripts/perf.py`; see docs/TESTING.md.; instructions_percent: per measured scenario, against perf/baselines; instructions_total_percent: sum over measured scenarios; phase_ms: min-of-5 duration of any startup phase; total_ms: min-of-5 one-shot total or REPL first prompt

defaults.why: Each scenario runs once unmeasured in a fresh hermetic home, so these exact; counts describe a warm second start. Scenarios override what they persist.

repl-completion.why: Tab on an empty line completes from the full command tree; Ctrl-C clears it.; Each entry is typed after the next prompt or menu paint.

plugin-describe-cold.why: A first start describes the plugin and saves the regenerable metadata cache:; one plugin exec, then a buffered atomic write (two cache directories, temp; file, rename) with no disk sync.

repl-history.why: Each new history entry is saved atomically (lock, temp file, rename) without; forcing a disk sync. The commands alternate so the warm run's entries are not; deduplicated away.

config-set.why: A saved setting takes the config lock and replaces the file atomically with; file and directory syncs.
